newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list Premier Laser, ProxyMed options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list Premier Laser, ProxyMed options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said it would list options on Premier Laser Systems Inc and ProxyMed Inc on July 9.
The Premier Laser options will have initial strike prices of 10, 12-1/2 and 15, with expirations in August, September, November and February. Position limits are 10,500 contracts.
Charlton, Goin SLK will be the specialist unit.
The ProxyMed options will have opening strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2, with expirations in August, September, October and January. Position limits are 4,500 contracts.
AGS Partners will be the specialist unit.
